# Small deterministic text fixtures

These renamed, unhinted subsets derive from the official Noto Sans CJK SC
Regular, Medium and Bold fonts at commit
165c01b46ea533872e002e0785ff17e44f6d97d8. They are test resources, not a general
font pack: unsupported characters deliberately remain unavailable.

The original font copyright and OFL metadata remain embedded, and OFL.txt
contains the governing license. Derivative family and PostScript identities are
VizIR Fixture SC / VizIRFixtureSC-{Regular,Medium,Bold}. Actual static weights
are 400, 500 and 700. No synthetic weight mapping is used.

manifest.json records source Git/SHA256 identities, exact retained characters,
fontTools version and resulting fixture hashes. To regenerate, supply those
three original files locally and run:

    python3 tools/subset_test_fonts.py /path/to/originals

Use fonttools==4.61.1. The script performs no network access, verifies source Git
blob hashes, fixes font timestamps and uses deterministic source/character order.
Normal cargo tests use the checked-in bytes and need no Python, downloads or
installed fonts. Full original fonts are intentionally not included.

The additional A/B-only VizIR Precision Fixture Regular is a small deterministic derivative for a valid fractional-font-unit contour. Its A is a thin diagonal quadrilateral; the pinned extraction cannot retain its filled ink, so measured compilation must reject A and AB rather than silently omit A. A blank space remains supported. It has separately renamed identities, the same retained OFL/copyright metadata, and is generated by the same script.
